principle: Independent intelligence. Shared knowledge. Recoverable work.

studies.title: Research Organization & Observatory
studies.objective: Organize investigations into a glanceable, connected, recoverable research landscape.

studies.title: Communication Between Research Entities
studies.objective: Find the simplest reliable way for independent participants to exchange tasks, findings, files, and acknowledgements.

studies.title: Persistent Research Memory
studies.objective: Keep findings, decisions, evidence, and open questions findable across sessions and interruptions.
studies.next_action: Compare Markdown plus Git with a structured index.

studies.title: Independent Research Entities
studies.objective: Test separate workers investigating independently and contributing compatible results.

studies.title: Continuity, Backup & Recovery
studies.objective: Restore research records and resume work after deletion, outage, or environment loss.
studies.next_action: Define recovery objectives and test a restore.

studies.title: Research Activity & Observability
studies.objective: Show progress, dependencies, blockers, discoveries, and next actions without opening chats.
studies.next_action: Specify the minimum useful dashboard fields.
